ambiguity.detail: The Dowager's relationship to the conspirators and her exact status remain vague.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: Conspirators plan to fabricate evidence of witchcraft to have a woman hanged by the state while dismissing a dying woman's warnings.
verdict.why_it_works: Detailed corruption and cold plotting build high tension around an impending judicial frame-up.
